support.notes: The macOS adapter has completed single-device HID, BLE ATVV, press/release and voice-stream acceptance. Two same-name Xiaomi remotes online at once still require explicit instance selection and are not covered by this status.

transports.notes: The ARN9 real-device test confirmed the same ATVV capability negotiation, microphone control and compressed voice stream used by the Xiaomi adapter family.
The ARN9 real-device test confirmed the hardware microphone F5 edge and its standard remote buttons through IOHID. The device has no TV button.

protocols.notes: Single-device real-hardware acceptance confirmed capability negotiation and balanced ATVV stream start/stop.

platforms.notes: Universal build target; single-device real-hardware acceptance performed on Apple Silicon.
No ARN9-specific Windows real-device acceptance has been completed.
No Open Voice Bridge Linux adapter has been implemented.
